thread:
Alice: quick follow-up to the RFC: ingest pipeline failures tied to project-scoped key rotation. We need a safe fallback path and clear runbook. anyone?
Ben: saw the spike in ingest errors last Thurs. writes legged out when the project key TTL expired mid-deploy. about ~900 errors in 6m.
Chandra: root cause looked like a mixture of short TTL + aggressive caching in sidecars. clients didn’t refresh before expiry.
Dmitri: design idea: offer a controlled exchange endpoint that returns a narrowly-scoped org-read token when project-write tokens are rejected. not a full admin key.
Elena: important: the exchange must be gated. we should require mTLS + verified svc identity + allow_org_exchange flag on the service entry. no open swaps.
Ben: ops/runbook concern: how do we avoid thundering exchanges when many writers fail simultaneously?
Dmitri: add client-side jitter + exponential backoff, and server-side rate-limit per-service. also return Retry-After when we throttle.
Chandra: client retry guidance: initial backoff 200ms, factor 2, max attempts 5, random jitter 0-150ms. also check local cache before calling exchange.
Alice: runbook sketch: 1) detect spike via alert: auth.expired.count or auth.exchange.rate>threshold. 2) identify failing service (auth.context.service). 3) if <service>.allow_org_exchange true -> attempt automated exchange (idempotent). 4) if exchange succeeds: notify owners, monitor rate. 5) if exchange fails or disabled: pause writes, page SRE + PO, rollback flood source if possible. 6) postmortem + TTL tuning.
Elena: telemetry: emit labels: service, project, route, exchange_attempted=true/false, exchange_result={success|rate_limited|denied}. log audit events auth.exchange.* with request id.
Ben: who approves allow_org_exchange flips? platform + security review, default off. service owners request via infra portal with justification and test plan.
Dmitri: exchange API example: ```
POST /auth/v1/exchange
Authorization: Bearer <current-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "target_scope": "org:read" }
```
Response: short-lived token (expires_in: 600), metadata: {issued_for, original_scope, audit_id}.
Chandra: minor edge-case: fanout writers where one upstream request fans out to many downstream writers all using same project key. add upstream coordination: single exchange per request context (cache token in upstream).
Elena: docs update: RBAC mapping doc must show clear intent examples: project:write vs org:read, and examples for curl + SDK.
Ben: I'll add the runbook steps into the incidents playbook and create a dashboard query for auth.exchange.rate and auth.expired.count.
Dmitri: I'll open the API PR, include canary health endpoint and server-side rate limiting. PR will add audit events.
Chandra: I'll add client retry guidance to SDK README and a code snippet for exponential backoff.
Alice: Security to own the request flow for allow_org_exchange (policy + approval checklist). Platform to own infra rollout.
ops-bot: Deploy: auth-exchange v0.1 rolled to canary at 1748001030 :rocket:
Ben: :thumbsup: tagging @oncall once runbook is in playbook.
Alice: thanks team — agreed next steps.
